# GenCatalog

> Local AI image and video organizer for Grok Imagine, GPT Image, Rogue Studio, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Digen, and Venice.ai. Captures prompts, metadata, and media automatically. Everything stored locally — nothing uploaded anywhere.

## What it does

GenCatalog helps creators recover, remember, and rediscover AI-generated images and videos by keeping files, prompts, source context, notes, and generation details together in a local library.

- Browse, search, and filter your entire AI media library
- Recover old AI work from folders, favorites, downloads, and platform histories
- Full prompt and creative recipe preserved with every generation when available
- Supports Grok Imagine, GPT Image, Rogue Studio, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Digen, and Venice.ai
- Color-coded source badges, star ratings, tags, notes, saved searches
- Sub-second grid load times, tested with catalogs of 30,000+ items
- Compare mode: view two generations side by side
- Bulk operations: tag, move, or export dozens of items at once

## Pricing

$79 one-time purchase. Includes all 5.x updates. Free trial: 7 days or 250 saved generations, whichever comes first — no credit card required.

## Privacy

Everything is stored locally on your machine. The GenCatalog app never uploads anything anywhere. No cloud, no accounts, no subscription.

## Requirements

- macOS or Windows 10/11
- Chrome browser (for the extension)
